escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"escape_asterisks\":true,\"escape_underscores\":false}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
